title: gcp-deploy deployment.yaml
description: Schema for the operator-supplied deployment.yaml consumed by the gcp-deploy skill.

client_name.description: Short lowercase client identifier used as a resource-name prefix. 2-31 characters, a-z 0-9 hyphen.

gcp_project_id.description: GCP project ID. 6-30 characters, a-z 0-9 hyphen, must start with a letter.

region.description: GCP region for all regional resources. Default: asia-southeast1.

image.description: Full container image URI with tag (e.g. ghcr.io/eriklacson/leansec-nuclei:latest). Omit this block to use the skill's baked-in default.

enable_scheduler.description: Provision Cloud Scheduler to trigger scans on a cron schedule. Default: true.

enable_wif.description: Provision Workload Identity Federation for external CI access. Default: false.

enable_ar_mirror.description: Provision an Artifact Registry repository for mirroring the GHCR scanner image. Default: false.

cron.description: Cron expression for the scheduled scan. Default: first Sunday of month at 02:00.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name for the scheduler. Default: Etc/UTC.

file.description: Path to the targets file, relative to deployment.yaml. Default: ./targets.txt.
